card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 loose shelves are finished choice, A3 missing supports become a complete kit and A5 one installed shelf becomes a finished approval sample.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 support fault causes A3 kit label; B4 paid installation and drill cause A5 minimal work recast as sample completion.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies a real defect and B4 insists on the purchased service with a practical tool.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes the kit defense, so A5 performs a little work while preserving the claim of a thoughtful completed version.

specificity.evidence: A1 cupboard and B2 falling shelves establish what unfinished work means concretely.
